one_liner: Revenue and traffic totals per BUSINESS revenue stream (DOMAIN/MAGIC/SEARCH/POPUP/SHOPNOMIX) — the direct answer to 'per revenue stream' questions.
description: One row per business revenue stream, with the full funnel and financials. This is the ONLY report that exposes the REVENUE_STREAM column directly — use it whenever the user asks for anything 'per revenue stream' or names a business stream (DOMAIN, MAGIC, SEARCH, POPUP, SHOPNOMIX). Do NOT use TRAFFIC_SOURCE_ENUM on another report for this: that column returns only the technical types (Search/Domain/Pop Up) and hides MAGIC and SHOPNOMIX inside them. This report has NO other breakdown dimensions (no feed, advertiser, campaign, geo) — it is a pure stream-level rollup; for per-feed or per-advertiser detail use MasterReportRow.
scope_and_overlap: Covers ALL Zeropark traffic, already split by business revenue stream — the streams are mutually exclusive partitions, so their rows sum to the whole-Zeropark total with NO double counting. This report is self-contained: NEVER add it on top of MasterReportRow or a Search* report (that would count traffic twice). Use it ALONE for stream-level totals.

generation_options.filters_usage: Filters are FULLY SUPPORTED at generation time — pass them in generate_zeropark_report; do NOT defer filtering to SQL. Format: filters=[{"name": "REVENUE_STREAM", "values": ["MAGIC", "SHOPNOMIX"]}]. REVENUE_STREAM values are the business streams: DOMAIN, MAGIC, SEARCH, POPUP, SHOPNOMIX (uppercase). Omit the filter to get every stream (one row each).

time_aggregation.note: With BY_HOUR/BY_DAY/BY_MONTH a time column is ADDED AUTOMATICALLY to the report — do not put it in dimensions. These are the ONLY valid values; there is no week aggregation. With 'none' you get one row per revenue stream for the whole period. Use BY_HOUR only if directly asked; it is not a good idea for large reports.

generation_options.dates: date_from/date_to use 'YYYY-MM-DD HH' (hour precision, UTC). date_to is an EXCLUSIVE end boundary (a point in time): to cover a full day X, end at the NEXT day's 00. Yesterday = '2026-08-02 00' -> '2026-08-03 00'; last 7 full days = '2026-07-27 00' -> '2026-08-03 00'. Ending at 'X 23' drops the 23:00-23:59 hour — never do that for whole-day ranges.

columns._metric_notes: PROFIT = ADVERTISER_COST - PUBLISHER_PAYOUT. MARGIN = PROFIT / ADVERTISER_COST (aggregate it weighted: SUM(PROFIT)/SUM(ADVERTISER_COST), never average the row values). ADVERTISER_COST = Zeropark revenue (money advertisers spent). PUBLISHER_PAYOUT = traffic cost. Funnel order: RAW_VISITS -> TOTAL_VISITS (after filtering) -> WINS -> SOLD_VISITS; INVALID_VISIT is RTB post-click invalidation, excluded from SOLD. 'net revenue' usually means PROFIT (gross profit) — confirm if ambiguous.
